name: sources
author: c-wenlong
description: Passphrase-encrypted browser for the private sources archive (YouTube transcripts, blogs, newsletters, papers, personas): categories, sources, authors, personas and a reader. nginx serves the AES-256-GCM build on 127.0.0.1:8098 behind Serve; deployd polls the remote every minute and rebuilds when the fetch clone at ~/dev/sources moves, so the weekly fetch commit goes live on the next tick. Unlock with the same SITE_PASSPHRASE as the GitHub Pages site. ~/services/sources/bin/deploy.sh --force rebuilds now.
